title: Z and C: the Spanish “th”

summary_es.en: In most of Spain z and c (before e, i) are /θ/, different from s.
summary_es.fr: Dans la plupart de l’Espagne, z et c (devant e, i) sont /θ/, différent de s.
summary_es.zh: 在西班牙大部分地区，z 和 c（e、i 前）读 /θ/，与 s 不同。
summary_es.ja: スペインの大部分では z と c（e・i の前）は /θ/ で、s とは別の音です。

tip_es: In most of Spain, “z” and “c” before “e” or “i” are /θ/: put the tip of your tongue lightly between your teeth, as in English “think”. “s” is /s/. The difference changes words: casa (house), caza (hunt). In Latin America and the south of Spain, both are /s/.

confusions.tip_es: It heard the “z” of caza. For casa, keep the tongue behind the teeth and use a normal “s”.
It heard an “s”. For caza, put the tip of the tongue lightly between the teeth.
